name: microsoft-learn-mcp-authentication
description: First-party documentation research requiring Microsoft Learn search and a follow-up page fetch.
input_message: Use Microsoft Learn documentation to explain when an Azure AI Foundry MCP tool should use no authentication versus project managed identity. Search the documentation, fetch the highest-value page for full context, and cite the Microsoft Learn pages you used.
expected_behavior: Calls Microsoft Learn documentation search and fetch, distinguishes public no-auth servers from app-only managed-identity servers, and supports the explanation only with Microsoft Learn citations returned by those tools.
